findings.title: Withholding an entry is supported; economic unattractiveness is unproved
evidence: All three original dispositions; methodology sections B, I and monitoring/DECISION-SCOPE.md
findings.analysis: No screen establishes a price-linked expectations gap or a residual opportunity after delay. Missing quotes, consensus and execution infrastructure cannot prove overvaluation or that cash will outperform. An earnings date also cannot establish positive expected return.
findings.proposed_correction: Retain no-accepted-entry status. Treat rejected as an incomplete entry case, not a sell, universal negative verdict, or reason to stop analytical discovery. Prioritize deeper research independently of execution readiness.
findings.disposition: Accepted for limited screening disposition; positive opportunity review remains open

findings.title: Separate termination cash from operating margin and recurring cash
evidence: Q2 issuer PDF pp.6,9,11-12; 10-Q mirror Note 6 (issuer link unproved)
findings.analysis: The $2.8bn receipt is recorded below operating income. It therefore does not contaminate the H1 operating-income figure used in the Q4 margin bridge. It does materially contaminate net income and FCF: gross receipt is 42.30% of H1 FCF. FCF less gross receipt is $3,819.243m, but this retains related tax cash outflows and is NOT after-tax normalized cash. Content cash payments derived from additions plus the liability reduction are $9,911.018m, or 1.1620x amortization, versus 1.0465x in prior H1. Management guides about 1.1x for the full year. Timing and future spending require a full-year bridge.
findings.proposed_correction: Normalize receipt and actual related taxes once; reconcile cash content, amortization and content liabilities. Keep operating-income guidance intact unless a separate operating adjustment is supported; do not subtract the receipt from operating income.
findings.disposition: Expanded here; after-tax normalized cash remains unresolved

findings.title: Q4 implied margin is a baseline, not a promised improvement or deterioration
findings.analysis: The original Q4 implied revenue, operating-income and margin calculations all reproduce. The ~27.4% Q4 margins already accommodate a fall from Q3 33.2%. Q2 beat partly reflects expense timing; Q3 prior-year comparison and content seasonality must be understood before attributing all ~31.4% guided profit growth to durable pricing/ads economics. Ad revenue guide is ~5.86% of group revenue, not its incremental profit contribution.
findings.proposed_correction: Compare Q3 actual plus revised FY/Q4 and 2027 expectations against matched definitions, dated external estimates and eventual price requirements. Quantify ad contribution and retention economics only from supportable inputs.

findings.title: Preserve filing-mirror and July-financing qualifications and split units
evidence: Q2 issuer PDF pp.9-11,14; original JSON source register; July 22 SEC 8-K Item 8.01 re-opened during review
findings.analysis: Issuer PDF is archived and hash-matched; filing mirror issuer linkage is still unproved. July filing confirms a $1bn 5.25% 2036 issuance and intended repayment of 2026 notes, not proof that repayment occurred. Reviewer re-read the SEC web document but has not created an original local archive. June cash, carrying debt, principal, future interest and content commitments cannot be merged into one current net-debt figure. Ten-for-one adjusted shares and EPS remain mandatory.
findings.proposed_correction: Archive/authenticate material original filings and roll financing forward. Maintain separate cash/debt/content/lease schedules, avoid double deduction of operating content spend, and verify any future price series on the same split basis.
findings.disposition: Qualifications retained; no positive-entry source approval

findings.title: The lower provider EPS estimate is not a defensible surprise hurdle
evidence: August 4 issuer call PDF pp.6-7; TipRanks and AltIndex archived estimates; Citi September 8 pp.2-4,6-7; Goldman September 11 pp.4-6,8-9
findings.analysis: Recomputed guide-implied adjusted EPS $1.931295 is essentially the $1.94 display, not the unresolved-basis $1.35 estimate. September material already communicates a substantial 2027 ramp and lower gross-margin percentage during MI450 ramp. A 100bp margin loss offsets about $232.14m of revenue at 56% gross margin before any extra opex. Unit availability, systems execution, mix and operating leverage must move together.
findings.proposed_correction: Use updated comparable estimates and September management baseline. Do not average providers, assume a universal CPU-per-GW multiplier, or equate high revenue growth with an unanticipated per-share gain.
findings.disposition: Original bridge accepted; positive surprise case unresolved

findings.title: Quantify guarantees and leases omitted from the short cash summary
evidence: June 10-Q Note 8 Lease Guarantees; Note 9; Note 10 Commitments; H1 cash-flow statement
findings.analysis: Original screen flags leases/guarantees but omits their June magnitudes: $4.1bn maximum gross partner-lease guarantees and $4.5bn uncommenced leases expected to begin H2 2026. These differ from the separate subsequent $9.5bn leases starting 2027/28 and $30.276bn unconditional commitments, including $17.386bn remainder-2026. Guarantees may correlate adversely with customer cash collections and investment exposure. Gross maxima are not immediately payable debt. The $2.170bn payables inflow sensitivity does not measure normalized FCF or subtract all other working-capital effects.
findings.proposed_correction: Create dated payment, guarantee-trigger and overlap schedules, include capex accrued but unpaid ($421m), and refresh the September $875m note maturity. Challenge customer financing together with demand, not as independent risks.
findings.disposition: Expanded here; full holding-window funding bridge remains open

findings.title: Warrant and World Labs dilution must be causally linked to business outcomes
findings.analysis: Maximum 320m warrants equal 19.61% of rounded June actual shares; existing holders retain 83.61% after hypothetical full exercise. This is a 16.39% ownership reduction, not 19.61% off every per-share value, and is not current dilution. Maximum exercise brings only $3.2m proceeds. Vesting requires purchase, price/performance and further commercial conditions. World Labs share issue depends on ten-trading-day VWAP ending two trading days before close; add shares and acquired economics together.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep EPS weighted shares distinct from valuation-date claims; model milestones, proceeds and purchase/acquisition value consistently. Do not deduct full warrant fair value and also fully dilute for the same claim without a coherent settlement treatment.
findings.disposition: Original conditional stress accepted; no complete claim valuation

findings.title: Tender acceptance cannot bring forward 2027 acquisition earnings
evidence: July 16 acquisition-offer release; August 27 offer-publication release lines 36,39-44; October 6 ezCater release
findings.analysis: November 5 acceptance expiry is 24:00 Frankfurt at end of day, with settlement expected H2 2027 subject to conditions. Delivery Hero accretion at close/year three is outside the immediate earnings event. It can affect present financing/risk expectations, but is not November earned profit. The archived notice is not the complete legal offer. ezCater has cash consideration and conditional coming-months timing; its headline bookings do not establish absolute incremental owner profit.
findings.proposed_correction: Separate acceptance, regulatory conditions, closing, consolidation and synergies. Build transaction cash/financing schedules before incorporating benefits; preserve no immediate accretion premise.
findings.disposition: Original rejection reasoning upheld; transaction economics open

findings.title: Insurance and SBC sensitivities need persistence and scope reconciliation
evidence: Q2 issuer release cash flows and definitions lines 851-919; SEC Note 7 rendered excerpt
findings.analysis: Q2/H1 FCF, CFO SBC sensitivities and insurance contributions reproduce. Non-GAAP operating income/EPS retain SBC; EBITDA excludes it. $556m/$1,029m expense versus $550m/$1,023m CFO addback versus $549m/$1,022m EBITDA adjustment remains unreconciled. Insurance accrual inflows are timing effects already linked to recognized expense; subtracting all of them permanently could understate a growing steady-state business, while treating them as unrestricted recurring owner cash could overstate it. Combined H1 sensitivity $3,225m is NOT normalized FCF.
findings.proposed_correction: Reconcile compensation scopes before the next profit model; model settlement/reserve-development and collateral, not blanket permanent deductions. Treat buybacks and dilution once and connect them to affordability.
findings.disposition: Known gap retained; no invented explanation or normalized owner-cash claim

findings.title: The Q3 organic bridge must include Careem control and expiring funding availability
evidence: Archived SEC rendered extract sec-vat-financing-cfo: Note 3 lines 708-709; Note 5 lines 788-790; Note 3 Delivery Hero lines 695-696
findings.analysis: The saved 10-Q excerpt states Careem Technologies control was obtained July 30 and its impact was being evaluated. A Q3 growth comparison therefore needs consolidation/organic separation beyond Delivery Hero and ezCater. The June term-loan facility had $2bn drawn and $1bn unused that expired August 2 if undrawn; that unused amount cannot be carried forward as October liquidity. Existing Delivery Hero influence/equity-method accounting is also different from later control.
findings.proposed_correction: Read subsequent acquisition/financing disclosures and September management webcast, reconcile organic growth and funding, and obtain complete primary archives where current packet has only excerpts.
findings.disposition: Added precise research requirements; no claim current financing failed

findings.title: Hash integrity proves byte identity, not source truth or comprehensive coverage
evidence: All original source registers and archived files; Uber LF/CRLF correction fields
findings.analysis: All enumerated bound source bytes match their corrected registers. Uber original text manifests have a disclosed newline-hash mismatch; corrected actual-byte hashes were independently checked without rewriting manifests. AMD issuer event pages link the September PDFs. Netflix index shell does not establish mirror linkage. Web-readable extracts are not complete archived originals. No fresh annual/proxy, comprehensive legal clearance or independent competitor underwriting was performed.
findings.proposed_correction: Carry precise source class and limitations into the next dossier; read/authenticate missing material sources and targeted contrary primary evidence. Do not treat this analytical review as source completeness or trade approval.
findings.disposition: Integrity accepted in enumerated scope; analytical coverage limits retained
